problem_statement: Teams want to trigger a GitHub Copilot CLI code review of a Git repository from a service endpoint, powered by their own Azure AI Foundry model deployment, without giving each user a GitHub Copilot subscription.
hypothesis: A custom-container Python Azure Function hosting the @github/copilot CLI can perform a headless BYOK code review against a Foundry gpt-5.4-mini deployment (via COPILOT_PROVIDER_* env vars), invoked by a single button click from a notebook and returning inline markdown, without requiring any GitHub identity at runtime.
customer_scenario: Platform teams that want a lightweight, internal 'review this repo' button backed by their own Foundry model, without deploying a Copilot subscription per user.
data_requirements: No production data. Reviews a hardcoded public sample repository (default: Hsenrab/CodeReviewExample) shallow-cloned into /tmp inside the container.
security_notes: Prototype only. Function endpoint is protected by a function key. Scoped exception to the repo's MI-only convention: the AIServices account has disableLocalAuth=false so the Copilot CLI can present a static API key header (its BYOK mode cannot use AAD tokens). Function App still uses managed identity for ACR image pull and Function storage. Do not commit env/.env or any captured review output that may include sensitive repo content.
